spec.name: Furniture Bookcase
spec.description: A tall oak bookcase with a projecting crown and plinth, three open book-filled compartments, and fifteen individually colored volumes. Warm oak grain, worn cloth bindings, and cream page edges give this grounded survival furniture a cozy character. Front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tall oak bookcase with colorful individual books and open shelves. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
